question:
Select the appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

At the drop of a hat
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Willingness to do something instantly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"At the drop of a hat"** means a willingness to do something instantly, without any hesitation. (तुरंत कुछ करने की इच्छा)

 
 
• **Example: **She is always ready to help at the drop of a hat.
 
 
 
• **Willingness to do something instantly** refers to being ready and eager to take action immediately. (तुरंत कुछ करने की इच्छा)
 
 
• **Example: **He agreed to join the project at the drop of a hat.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Willingness to do something instantly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Become easily frightened** (आसानी से डर जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He becomes easily frightened when he hears loud noises.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Reveal a secret carelessly** (लापरवाही से एक रहस्य प्रकट करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She revealed the surprise party secret carelessly.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Crying without any reason** (बिना किसी कारण के रोना)
 
 
• **Example:** The baby was crying without any reason.
